Hence the pre-registered G(h) of S3 is 0 for every h: S3 fails as written; not changed.

task_a: one table reconciling: 8 copies on 2Z^3 (this study), 4 stroboscopic valleys (BATTIMENTO_1S), 4 massive + 4 massless-at-pi species (VUOTO_POLARIZZA). Bookkeeping only, numbers from locale_f3_run.json.

task_b.model: 3-D Dirac walk on a periodic 48^3 box (RealWalk of lab/locale_core.py), theta = 0.5 (cell = 0.5 lambda_C, as the Laboratory), Z = 60 (Z alpha = 0.4378), Coulomb phase exp(-i V T) applied once per 2-tick period (same for all walks; NOT the Laboratory's exact scheme, so absolute energies are not compared with BATTIMENTO). Nucleus on the CORNER (at (1/2,1/2,1/2) from a site, all r >= sqrt(3)/2) or at a CELL CENTRE (on a site; that site gets the cube average of -Z alpha / r, 2.3800/cell, declared). Initial state: exp(-r/a_B) x the positive-energy rest spinor (1,0,1,0)/sqrt2, only on sites of parity class (0,0,0) (one copy). Levels by filter diagonalization (Rayleigh-Ritz): 700 periods, Hann window, 31 filtered vectors for per-period phase in [0.80, 0.95] (= E/m since theta T = 1), Ritz on the 2-tick operator; residual reported.
task_b.walks: F0 frozen; F2 twisted Wilson h = 0.1 (phase 1); F2 h = 0.6 (argmax over the phase-3 h grid of the energy-0 doubler gap g0 at theta = 0.1: chosen AFTER seeing the scan, declared).

exams.V2_control: F0, corner: >= 3 Ritz levels in [0.80, 0.95] with weight >= 2 % each in the initial state (the multiplet is reproduced in this reduced model). If this fails, V3 is not interpretable.
exams.V3_wilson: F2 (h = 0.1 and h = 0.6), corner: exactly ONE level in [0.80, 0.95] with weight >= 2 %, carrying >= 90 % of the weight found in the window -> 'the valley split disappears'.
exams.V4_centre: the same counts for the nucleus on a cell centre (information, no threshold).
